snippet.title: Pidgeon Pocket | Cinema Update | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Your pigeons are the crew. The park is the mark.

Take a look at the new black-and-white Cinema park, with 1930s outfits, film-inspired menus and heist combos — alongside Park, Christmas, Halloween and Neon Night. Real in-game footage.

Play the free demo and wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4852570/Pidgeon_Pocket/

Free demo on itch.io:
https://lianes8.itch.io/pidgeon-pocket-demo

Early Access: 9 November 2026.
https://www.lianes8studio.com/pidgeon

#PidgeonPocket #IndieGame #IncrementalGame
